note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled offline at backend/library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz (founder decision 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere). Every quotation was re-quoted from it verbatim, spliced by script: a whole verse where Evans quotes one, the shortest contiguous OWB span where he quotes a clause. It replaces the 1962 UBS text and the translator's own renderings this edition first carried.

A `mined` row means the quoted words are a verbatim OWB substring; its source_file names the edition. Four rows stay self_rendered: Isaiah 59:19 (OWB reads the verse as the LORD coming like a pent-up river, so Evans's 'the enemy has come in like a flood' has no OWB wording to quote); Daniel 5:25 and 5:27 (Evans's exclamations 'Mene! Tekel!' / 'Wanting! wanting!', not quotations of the verse text); Ephesians 2:1 (OWB addresses 'you', Evans applies it to 'them').
